warning: Observed defect counts, not defect rates or root causes. Each report must cover a disjoint group of units with one primary defect; duplicate IDs alone cannot detect duplicated physical units. Held reports are excluded from the Pareto denominator but preserved. Rework minutes are user-supplied planning estimates, not measured savings. Focus is the smallest descending prefix reaching the target (ties ordered by category ID), not proof of the 80/20 rule. Confirm source counts and investigate before acting.
